subtitle.zh-TW: 鯊魚是旁觀者昨天自己放的，這次他要為孩子的死負責。
subtitle.en: The sharks are there because the bystander released them yesterday, so this time he answers for the death.

story.zh-TW: 考慮與鯊魚案例相近的情境。孩子溺水，路人不去救，但這回水裡的鯊魚是他昨天疏忽放進去的；他沒有任何理由放鯊魚，也有充分理由不該放。今天他看見孩子溺水，知道鯊魚在水裡，認為下水救人只是白費，所以沒有下水。
story.en: Consider a situation close to the Sharks case. A child is drowning and the bystander does not try to save him, but this time the sharks are in the water because he negligently released them yesterday; he had no good reason to release them and good reason not to. Today he sees the child drowning, knows the sharks are there, takes a rescue to be pointless, and stays out of the water.

zh-TW.sentence: 但這回水裡的鯊魚是他昨天疏忽放進去的；他沒有任何理由放鯊魚，也有充分理由不該放。
今天他看見孩子溺水，知道鯊魚在水裡，認為下水救人只是白費，所以沒有下水。

en.sentence: but this time the sharks are in the water because he negligently released them yesterday; he had no good reason to release them and good reason not to.
Today he sees the child drowning, knows the sharks are there, takes a rescue to be pointless, and stays out of the water.

text.zh-TW: 鯊魚是他放的，孩子的死可以追溯到這個行動；他因此要為沒有救人負責。
text.en: He put the sharks there, so the death traces back to his act; that is why he answers for not saving the child.

explanation.zh-TW: 在鯊魚案例的模型上加一個變數 R：昨天放了鯊魚（外生，實際為 1），鯊魚在水裡就是 R（SK = R）。路人只在水裡沒有鯊魚時才會下水（J = ¬SK），因此今天他沒有下水（J = 0）。孩子獲救要求下水而且沒有鯊魚（SV = J·¬SK），溺斃就是沒有獲救（DR = ¬SV）。Sartorio 的論證是：責任經由因果傳遞，放鯊魚是孩子死亡的原因，而今天不下水不是，因為下水也救不了。引擎證實前半：R = 1 是 DR = 1 的 but-for 原因。後半在 but-for 下成立，但原定義的 HP 允許撤回放鯊魚（R = 0），鯊魚就不在水裡，於是把「沒下水」也算成原因；更新版 HP 用同一個見證，結果相同。本模型的方程式與變數是依故事擬定的。
explanation.en: The model extends the Sharks model with R, releasing the sharks yesterday (exogenous, actually 1); the sharks are in the water exactly when R holds (SK = R). The bystander enters the water only when there are no sharks (J = ¬SK), so today he does not (J = 0). The child is saved only if he jumps in and there are no sharks (SV = J·¬SK), and drowns if not saved (DR = ¬SV). Sartorio's argument is that responsibility transmits through causation: releasing the sharks is a cause of the death, while today's staying out is not, since jumping in would not have helped. The engine confirms the first half: R = 1 is a but-for cause of DR = 1. The second half holds under but-for, but the original HP definition may undo the release (R = 0), so the sharks are absent, and it counts staying out as a cause as well; the updated definition does the same with the same witness. The variables and equations are built from the story here; the literature gives no equations.

sources.citation: Sartorio, C. (2005). A new asymmetry between actions and omissions. Noûs, 39(3), 460–482.

note.zh-TW: p.469 給出 Planted Sharks 的敘述與論證 (7)–(12)；p.469–470 說明為什麼不下水本身不是死亡的原因。
note.en: P. 469 states Planted Sharks and the argument (7)–(12); pp. 469–470 explain why his not jumping in is not itself a cause of the death.

verdicts.note: Same witness as the original definition: R set to 0.

label.en: He did not release the sharks

label.zh-TW: 鯊魚在水裡，路人仍下水
label.en: Sharks are there, yet he jumps in
